methodologyNotes: 14 notable portable power stations selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the full range from compact travel-size (245 Wh) to semi-permanent home-backup (4,096 Wh base). Seeds from the brief were verified against current product listings: Jackery Explorer 300 Plus is discontinued (UK site confirms 'new version expected late 2026') and replaced with the current in-market Explorer 300 Plus (still available via uk.jackery.com); Jackery Explorer 2000 Plus is discontinued (UK site explicit) and replaced with Explorer 2000 v2 (2042 Wh, actively sold); Goal Zero 'Yeti 500' was verified as 'Yeti 500X' (497 Wh, confirmed at goalzero.com). Bluetti 'Elite 200 V2' confirmed active at $799 MSRP via bluettipower.com homepage. EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max and Anker SOLIX S2000 added as major 2025-2026 releases that buyers are actively comparing. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (bluettipower.com, goalzero.com, us.ecoflow.com, uk.jackery.com, ca.jackery.com, ankersolix.com). Fallback sources: electrek.co reviews for confirmed specs. Dynamic pricing (JavaScript-rendered) blocked US prices from rendering for Jackery and Anker SOLIX — UK/CA site prices converted or marked null per null-over-guess rule. specKeys chosen to be real and comparable across all 14 units: capacity_wh (integer, usable Wh), ac_output_w (integer, continuous rated watts), battery_chemistry (string: 'LFP' or 'NMC'), recharge_full_min (integer, minutes to full charge from AC wall outlet; null when only 0-80% time published), weight_lb (float), outlets_ac (integer, count of standard AC outlets), expandable (boolean, whether capacity can be increased with add-on battery packs), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.
